stimulus:
I wandered lonely as a cloud
That floats on high o'er vales and hills,
When all at once I saw a crowd,
A host, of golden daffodils;
Beside the lake, beneath the trees,
Fluttering and dancing in the breeze.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Lone cloud, then crowd: single-cell AP-1 history tracking
ideas.description: Live-image endogenous FOS/JUN with knock-in fluorescent reporters (and a stable lineage tracker) in single cells through a first stimulus, a rest period, and a second stimulus. Test whether prior activation history predicts the amplitude or kinetics of the second response, as a wanderer's earlier path predicts where they meet the crowd.

ideas.title: Daffodil field mapping: ATAC/CUT&RUN of AP-1 bound latent enhancers
ideas.description: Profile AP-1 binding (JUN/FOS CUT&RUN), chromatin accessibility and H3K27ac before, after and long after stimulus withdrawal. Identify enhancers that stay open or primed after AP-1 levels return to baseline, and test whether they are the sites that drive faster or stronger reactivation.

ideas.title: Breeze-off test: acute AP-1 degradation after priming
ideas.description: Prime cells, then use degron-tagged (dTAG/auxin) JUN/FOS or a dominant-negative such as A-FOS to remove AP-1 at defined times: during priming only, during the rest period only, or at restimulation. Compare enhancer accessibility and transcriptional memory to separate AP-1 as the initiator of memory from AP-1 as its maintainer.

ideas.title: Dancing in sync: dynamics-encoded memory via optogenetic pulse patterns
ideas.description: Drive AP-1 with optogenetic or chemogenetic input using varied pulse number, frequency and duration, then measure target gene output and chromatin state after a delay. Fit a model, such as a bistable or hysteresis model, to ask whether AP-1 dynamics encode a persistent state that depends on the history of the input.

ideas.title: Lineage inheritance across divisions with sister-cell and single-cell multiome
ideas.description: Track primed cells through mitosis with time-lapse imaging, or barcode them, then run paired scRNA/scATAC on sisters and distant relatives. Test whether the primed AP-1 target state is inherited, decays at a measurable rate, and is shared more by clonally related cells than by random cells, which would show cell-autonomous heritable memory and not just a persistent external signal.
